text: This dictionary aims to provide a basic vocabulary of British and American terms relating to the three services, and covers subjects such as rank, organization, training, operations in the field, logistics, radio communications, and some of the more common weapons and equipment currently in use.
text_raw:
This dictionary aims to provide a basic vocabulary of
British and American terms relating to the three services, and covers subjects such
as rank, organization, training, operations in the field, logistics, radio
communications, and some of the more common weapons and equipment
currently in use.

text: In addition, there are selected items of general vocabulary relating to geography, terrain, weather, medical treatment and other relevant matters.
text_raw:
In addition, there are selected items of general vocabulary
relating to geography, terrain, weather, medical treatment and other relevant
matters.

text: New terms used by the media in reporting on recent conflicts are also included, making this an ideal reference source for anyone involved in teaching English to the military or armed police forces.

Air Combat Command is

tegic Air Command (SAC) which
was responsible for heavy long-
range bombers and ICBMs and the
former Tactical Air Command

of the word regiment is rather con-
fusing, since it no longer refers to a
tactical grouping of two or more bat-
talions (the British use a brigade of
